value.rationale: An unknown least extremal boundary would be worthwhile, but here the result simply reads off the cases of a known general classification. The target coefficient statement is also covered by an exact multiplicity result, and the remaining smaller-row all-coefficient statement is a routine two-column no-carry observation. The short independent proof is useful exposition but leaves no distinct substantive boundary result to repair.
